text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Summer Training Camp season had 
arrived once again. However, the rivals 
who ran across the same sandy beach last 
year were no longer here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Everyone has found their own Marvelous and 
is running toward it. Let's attain a 
brilliance that won't lose to anyone this 
summer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—And so, an intensely Marvelous summer 
training camp with Marvelous Sunday had 
begun!
